ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heaviness appeals to me, but I want something more aggressive today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Ten Thousand Fists is a recent listen, so I would choose more Disturbed with strong vocals and heavy riffs.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, repetitive sound is less appealing right now than the melodic and intricate heavy music I have been exploring.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its unpredictable rhythms and mix of melody and aggression after listening to Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its combination of abrasive riffs and melodic passages given my recent heavy listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More Disturbed fits my current interests, but I would try Believe first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: WAKING THE FALLEN; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic metal riffs and aggressive vocals fit my interest in In Flames and heavier albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: L.D. 50       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intricate rhythms interest me after Tool, but I would save this for another listening session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wonder What's Next; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy, melodic rock fits my listening history, though other choices catch my attention more today.
